_comment: True prodrugs — the parent is essentially inactive and what a person feels is an active metabolite. The effect TIMELINE is driven by the durations table and is already right; this fixes the BODY-LOAD / elimination readouts (Active Now %, cleared time, the PK tools, the PDF PK chart), which read the substance's half-life and otherwise say a prodrug is cleared while the person is still dosed. Each entry gives the felt-duration half-life to resolve: `via_substance` borrows a catalog metabolite's own stored half-life (the number is the metabolite's own, shown as its row shows it — the curated claim is the prodrug->metabolite link, also in `metabolism`, so no separate citation is needed), or an explicit `half_life_minutes` + `citation` for a metabolite Piru has no standalone row for. Written as a piru-curated half_lives row that wins the source order over the parent's measured plasma value (which stays under its own source). This is the data-layer twin of the felt-effect ke patches in SubstanceModelDatabase.swift, generalized and moved into the data. Only TRUE prodrugs belong here; a drug with active metabolites that merely extend its own action (codeine, oxycodone, tramadol, diazepam, venlafaxine) keeps its own half-life. An entry whose prodrug or metabolite is absent, or whose metabolite has no stored half-life, is logged and skipped at build.

entries.note: Diacetylmorphine's plasma half-life is ~2-8 min; the felt duration is 6-monoacetylmorphine and morphine.

Therapeutically inactive; hydrolyzed to d-amphetamine (t1/2 ~9.7 h single-dose, ~10.1 h steady-state). The stored 25 min is the intact prodrug. d-amphetamine is a stereoisomer facet of Amphetamine, so the value is explicit.
Pure prodrug for modafinil; its own plasma half-life ~1 h, wakefulness lasts most of a day.
Dephosphorylated to psilocin, the active species.
Prodrug for LSD (was previously stored with LSD's value directly; now via the link).
Decarboxylated in the stomach to nordazepam, which carries the whole effect.
Prodrug metabolized to diazepam and onward to nordazepam.
Metabolized to phenobarbital (and PEMA); phenobarbital governs the long tail.
